jobs.title: Security Supervisor – Pediatric Hospital Leadership
jobs.description:
Lurie Children’s Hospital of Chicago is seeking a Security Officer Supervisor to lead front-line teams on site, ensuring a safe environment for patients, families, staff and volunteers. Responsibilities encompass patrols, incident reporting, access control, dispatch operations, and emergency response across the Medical Center campus.
